visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long, disheveled dark hair and a stubbled chin looks directly into the lens of a smartphone camera. He is wearing a dark grey t-shirt and intentionally makes a grotesque face by pulling his jaw back to create a prominent double chin. Behind him are several colorful plush toys, including a SpongeBob SquarePants figure and a pink octopus, resting on a bed in a well-lit indoor room. (2) The screen dims significantly, and a circular loading progress bar appears in the center. Purple and white graphic overlays from a mobile app interface are visible, showing an AI processing animation with percentages climbing from 30% to 48%. Chinese characters indicate that an AI effect is being generated by the WHEE software. (3) The video cuts to a stylized triptych split-screen showing a dramatic transformation. The man is now depicted as a handsome, melancholic character in a snowy forest. He wears a thick black puffer jacket and a large scarf, holding a transparent umbrella as snowflakes fall around him. The background is a dense, snow-laden woodland with high-contrast cinematic lighting.
